name: Julie Johnson
bio: a Representative from Texas; born in Kansas City, Wyandotte County, Kans., May 2, 1966; graduated from Auburn High School, Auburn, Ala., 1984; B.A., University of Texas at Austin, Austin, Tex., 1987; J.D., University of Houston, Houston Tex., 1991; lawyer, private practice; member of the Texas state house of representatives, 2019-2025; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
